g.text: AD-03 · Order verification, payment and handover at the store (UC-06, BR-09, BR-18, BR-21)
Type the code and open order page /orders/{code}
offer to take a new order at the counter
Charge the total at the counter
Explain that the order was already collected
Explain that the order expired at closing time;
offer to take a new order
"Total a pagar na loja", first name only
The staff API has no UI (BR-21).
